resolution.note: preflight names the base-reviewer remedy; krn-lead routes schema PRs to the base reviewer

title: Ship review records that use a new schema enum value
body:
Outcome: a PR that adds an enum value to the review record schema (e.g. PR #170 prior finding role "prepass") can ship with its own review record. scripts/pr-preflight.mjs verifies records with the trusted base schema; since t-zwba7pr it strips keys the base schema does not know and re-validates, but an unknown enum value still fails ("review record does not satisfy the strict schema"). Dropping values could change a verdict, so the fix needs a trust argument (e.g. a base-side list of extensible enums), never executing head code.
Lead trap: when a PR adds an enum value to the review record schema, run its last review attempt in the base record shape (no new values) under a budget exception.
